title.zh: 查询自用户定义域名列表

descriptions.zh: 该接口用于获取用户已配置的自定义终端节点（Endpoint）列表，便于管理和查看私有连接或VPC终端服务的设置。
descriptions.en: Queries the list of custom endpoints configured by the user. You can use this operation to manage and view the settings of private connections or VPC endpoint services.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardbx describe-custom-endpoint-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-xxx --custom-endpoint-ids pxe-b6e0000no4pfap1s --check-delete-cn true --region cn-hangzhou
